caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent drinking glass placed upright against a plain, light beige background. The glass has a slightly flared rim and vertical grooves with curved, wavy patterns that run from the base to the top, giving it a textured appearance. The glass is rendered in pale blue and green tones, with careful attention to the reflections and shadows that suggest the way light interacts with the glass material. The surface of the background is even in color with slight variances and some visible texture, and there are no additional objects or elements present. In the lower right corner, there is a small signature and date written in a delicate script.
title: Water Glass
